required_stages.description: Element-wise: int8 x converted to fp32, multiplied by the fp32 row scale and by the fp32 constant 1/127.

Single rounding from fp32 to fp16 at the store into a freshly allocated (rows, cols) fp16 output, fused with s1 per element: no global intermediate and no second pass (the number of launches is a mapping choice).

forbidden_substitutions.message: library dequantisation replaces the whole computation
host-side tensor arithmetic performs the dequantisation
host-side broadcast multiply of the row scale
host-side cast of the int8 input (pre-cast copy is forbidden)
extra buffer; no intermediate is permitted (only the fp16 output via torch.empty)

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated (rows, cols) fp16 tensor on every call

timing_boundary.notes: All device work launched by run() is counted (the dequantisation launch(es)); host-side work (the fp16 output allocation call, shape reads) is not GPU time. No host-side cast, copy or transpose of x/state_x is permitted; no state across calls.
